source.method: deskew, tiled FLUX Klein 4x, cleanup (earlier rounds)

qa.note: base: logo, price, slogan, date band, stripes, backdrop; checked at 1:1.

parts.name: Cover photograph (woman in the gale, flying boat, skyline)

source.method: the photograph cut from the deskewed original (caption and body text inpainted out), alone through FLUX Klein 2 x 2x (seed 72), colour lock, sepia projection, tone match, rotated back to the page frame

qa.note: Photo alone through Klein; the flying-wing region is the original's own pixels (the redraw had given it cockpit windows and nacelles).

parts.name: Pale patches under the caption and pull quote

source.method: soft patches in the original's own pale street/sky colour (percentile of the original under each block), as the print has behind its text

qa.note: Pale patches as the print has behind its text.

parts.name: White caption over the skyline: POLICE HARASS CITIZENS!

source.method: Arial Bold, white, set along the original's own line (upright frame, rotated to the page)

qa.note: POLICE HARASS CITIZENS! retyped with a soft halo; legible.

parts.name: Pull quote column (Kurt Edwards) over the street

source.method: Bell MT at the print's measure, light ink (the print is pale and soft); wording as printed on the cover

qa.note: Pull quote retyped; legible on the pale patch.

parts.name: Target emblem (white disc, arc, red ring and line)

source.method: drawn as a vector (4x supersampled) from geometry measured on the original; the original's brightness decides where logo/slogan overlap the disc

qa.note: Vector target emblem matching the original.
